Who is Ancient Psychic Tandem War Elephant?

LEGO Dimensions|Species = Elephant|Years = 2016|Appearances = 71245 Adventure Time Level PackLEGO Dimensions}}The Ancient Psychic Tandem War Elephant is a minifigure introduced in LEGO Dimensions in 2016.

He first appeared in "The Limit" where Finn wished for him at the center of the magic labyrinth.
